references.text: Moses meets God's people in the wilderness and ensures they receive food from heaven, reflecting how Jesus provides food for the people.
A psalm that reminds us of God's ability to provide food for His people in the wilderness, parallel to Jesus' miracle.
Another event where Jesus feeds a large crowd, demonstrating His care and ability to provide.
Mark's version of the event where Jesus feeds 5,000, showing Jesus' miraculous power to provide.
Luke's account of how Jesus feeds a large crowd, emphasizing His compassion and divine power.
John's detailed description of the miracle of feeding the 5,000, highlighting Jesus' ability to meet human needs in supernatural ways.
